comparison.objective: Assemble a 2×2 battery pack by placing holder halves and inserting four correctly oriented cells; candidate tunes and tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR performs repeated tight peg-in-cup insertions and fixture alignment. Candidate performs fine hex engagement, torque, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires all cells seated positive-up, top holder aligned within 2 mm, and the assembly still. Candidate requires two force/travel-safe stops and no lock drift.
comparison.reason: Precision assembly insertion is not the same tested ability as adjustable damping setup and dynamic validation.
